placements.title: Authority commands the erasure of a decision and its surrounding knowledge rather than revisiting either
placements.frame: What decision or body of knowledge is being ordered forgotten, and is the directive ever revisited, justified, or reversed?
placements.why: Both segments are bare imperatives from the same speaker in the same submission ordering erasure — first of a named decision ('the Quantum Widget Decision'), then of an entire body of institutional knowledge ('the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration') — with no justification or appeal to process. Pass-2 found no existing node anywhere in the perspective touching either the decision or the migration, and both EXISTING STRATA and EXISTING GRAPH STRUCTURE are empty for this repo, so nothing supplied can be reused or referenced as a parent/lineage target. The theme — authority enacted through commanding the organization to forget rather than debate — is a subject plausibly fed by future envelopes (further erasure directives, their reversals, or resistance to them), passing the narrative grain test rather than being a one-time fact. Minted standalone since no existing structure is even close enough to warrant a lineage edge.
